name: DRAGOON ARMOR FOR ADULT
source:
The lovely princess was abducted by a mysterious giant black bird. The bird carried the prisoner to a tower on the lake shore. Who would be brave enough to venture into the tower and to rescue the princess? Only the courageous knight Landis, aided by the Goddess herself!

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/dragoon-armor-for-adult]Moby Games[/url]]
translation:
可爱的公主被一只神秘的黑色巨鸟绑架了。这只鸟把囚犯带到了湖岸上的一座塔楼上。谁有勇气冒险进入塔楼拯救公主？只有勇敢的兰迪斯骑士，并得到女神本人的帮助！

[来自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/dragoon-armor-for-adult]Moby Games[/url]]
